verdicts.reason: A keeps the confetti strip and a large headline, but the lantern icon sits half on the busy confetti at the card edge, and the book cover awkwardly straddles the card border. The eyebrow wraps to leave an orphaned 'READERS', far from the headline, so the reading order jumps around (book, logo, eyebrow, body, then the headline at the bottom left). B has a clearer two-column grid and a dominant headline, but the card nearly fills the canvas, so the confetti brand texture shrinks to edge slivers. The headline also leaves an orphaned 'The' on its own line, the eyebrow is detached below the logo, out of reading order, and it also orphans 'READERS'. The tiny legal text is jammed beside the CTA.
